newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen down as Handlowy offer starts.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen down as Handlowy offer starts.

text.p: Polish shares are expected to extend last week's slight fall overshadowed by heavy primary market menu with Poland's biggest commercial bank Bank Handlowy SA starting its public offering on Monday.
Analysts said Handlowy's offer, attractively priced at between 28 and 35 zlotys per share, was likely to undermine the Warsaw Stock Exchange during the whole week.

Zaklad Elektrod Weglowych SA (ZEW) starts main market trade on Monday and analysts expected it to open just above its 45-zloty issue price set during its 800,000-share initial public offering in February.--Malgorzata Rzepka +48 22 653 9700
